overview: A one-page State Department list-of-papers sheet for decimal file 894.79694A, concerning aerial navigation and communications between Japan and Japanese-ruled Taiwan. It records a document dated October 12, 1935, reporting the inauguration of air service between Taiwan and Japan and the beginning of a preliminary weekly airmail service, with a related-file reference to 894.71294A.

people.name: Money
people.role: Person associated with the report from Taipei; precise position is not stated

subfiles.title: List of papers on air service between Japan and Taiwan
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a report on the inauguration of air service and preliminary weekly airmail between Japan and Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: This filing sheet identifies the subject as aerial navigation between Japan and Taiwan. Its sole entry records an October 12, 1935 report concerning the inauguration of an air link and the beginning of preliminary weekly airmail service. It also directs readers to related file 894.71294A.

interest: Although only an index sheet, the document pinpoints the early administrative record of a scheduled aviation and postal connection between metropolitan Japan and colonial Taiwan. It is useful for tracing the development of imperial communications infrastructure and, through its cross-reference to file 894.71294A, locating the fuller underlying report.
